top_signals.title: Democrat shaping AI policy bought chip stocks despite backing congressional trading ban
top_signals.summary: Rep. Josh Gottheimer disclosed new AI-linked stock purchases months after voting for a congressional trading ban, as Democrats prepare to regulate the industry.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Wall Street Strategists Call Stock Rout a Fresh Reason to Buy
top_signals.summary: A slew of Wall Street strategists were banking on a short-term selloff following the US midterm elections to give investors an opportunity to buy stocks at a discount.
